note: BCR's costs for its Standard credit card: 45 lei a year to administer, and a fixed 28% a year on an unsecured card (23% on one secured by a deposit, which the game doesn't hold). The 20-lei issue fee is not written. Banca Transilvania's tariffs answered with a bot check and weren't read.

sources.title: BCR, Costuri pentru cardul de credit BCR Standard
sources.said: Costuri pentru cardul de credit BCR Standard ... Administrare anuală a cardului principal/ 45 lei ... 28%/an fixă pentru carduri negarantate
